entities.summary: Paolo Barilla is a businessman and winner of the 1985 24 Hours of Le Mans. A former Formula One driver who raced for the Minardi team, Barilla is now the Deputy Chairman of the Barilla Group and, as of January 2017, had a net worth of US$1.39 billion.
